public.text: Drawing on authoritative registries is described as making outputs traceable to sources. Source traceability depends on preserved provenance through extraction, transformation, feature creation, model training, retrieval, and inference.
public.suggestedRevision: Require end-to-end data lineage and provenance, including source version, transformations, model version, prompt or configuration where relevant, retrieved sources, and output audit information.
